# Comfy Seedance 2.5- Reference to Video

Generate reference-driven videos with Seedance 2.5 by supplying up to 20 images, 6 video clips, and 6 audio clips to control character consistency, visual style, and motion rhythm in a single 4–30 second output with synchronized sound and lip-synced dialogue. Ideal for e-commerce product showcases, brand advertising, and character-driven short series. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_seedance2_5_r2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: The crimson marble Medusa statue comes alive, opening her eyes and looking at the camera while the red typography in the background simultaneously dissolves away letter by letter into drifting red particles. The snakes in her hair rise and sway. Both the statue and the background text animate together, poster layout otherwise unchanged, cinematic, no black frames.
